newsitem.title: YEMEN: Explosions rock Yemen's Aden, no casualty reports.
newsitem.headline: Explosions rock Yemen's Aden, no casualty reports.

text.p: Three explosive devices blew up in different parts of the Yemeni port city of Aden on Monday but did not cause any casualties or damage, a security source said.
"The first explosion took place beside a gasoline station while the two others occurred on the road to the airport in the district of Khor Maksar," the source told Reuters.
Security personnel also defused a landmine close to an ammunition dump in Aden's Jebel district, he said.
Yemeni security officials were investigating the explosions.
